name: Xoi trung kien
summary: Sticky rice with brown-ant eggs from Nho Quan, made only in February. The eggs pop when you bite them.
howToEat: Eat the rice with fried shallot.
seoTitle: Xoi trung kien — ant-egg sticky rice
seoDescription: Nho Quan sticky rice with brown-ant eggs that pop when you bite them, made only in February.
